executive_narrative.title: SkyHarbor Air: Turning fragmented operational signals into owned, board-grade recovery decisions
executive_narrative.thesis: SkyHarbor's next value step is not a new platform but faster, safer, cheaper recovery when the operation breaks. Today the enterprise context is directionally rich but planning-grade: ownership, certified data lineage, baselines, and control evidence are missing. The agenda is to convert planning-grade context into board-grade decisions before scaling AI into safety-adjacent operations.
executive_narrative.narrative_arc: We frame where operating value actually leaks in a disruption; separate loaded context from board-grade truth; expose ownership and decision-rights gaps; name the bounded recovery workflows worth qualifying; convert evidence gaps into a validation gate; and close on the leadership decisions on the table now.
strategic_agenda: Act: assign accountable owners for IROPS recovery, crew legality, and data governance; certify disruption, crew, bag-scan, and maintenance-event lineage; establish a measured disruption-cost and recovery-time baseline.

Build: prove one crew-legality-safe, human-in-the-loop recovery decision-support workflow and one reaccommodation/notification assist against a measured baseline; validate managed-services data-access rights.
Scale: extend proven recovery workflows across hubs with governed controls; sequence mainframe/MQ modernization behind proven operational demand; institutionalize value tracking for IROPS outcomes.

enterprise_thesis.title: The prize is recovery speed, not another platform
enterprise_thesis.headline: Disruption recovery and crew-legality risk dominate this archetype's economics
enterprise_thesis.executive_takeaway: As a full-service global network carrier, SkyHarbor concentrates avoidable cost in disruption cascades, crew reassignment, and passenger reaccommodation, where minutes of decision latency convert to material cost and NPS erosion. The value case is real and directional, but no certified disruption-cost baseline or accountable owner yet exists, so scale investment cannot be justified as proven today.

key_insights.statement: Network-airline value leakage concentrates in IROPS recovery, not in steady-state flying.
Loaded functions span Flight Ops, Crew, Maintenance, Customer, Cargo, and Loyalty, aligning to recovery workflows.
No production IROPS AI outcome is evidenced; the case remains directional.

enterprise_thesis.strategic_implication: Lead with recovery economics; treat platform modernization as an enabler that follows proven operational demand.
recommended_actions: Anchor the transformation on a measured disruption-cost and recovery-time baseline before any scale commitment.
enterprise_thesis.confidence_statement: Directional strategic inference grounded in archetype patterns; not yet source-backed to a certified baseline.

leadership_agenda.title: Establish truth and ownership before scaling AI
leadership_agenda.headline: Five decisions gate the transformation; most are evidence requests, not build approvals
leadership_agenda.executive_takeaway: Leadership can act now on ownership and evidence: name a single accountable IROPS-recovery owner, fund lineage certification, commission a managed-services scope-and-data-rights review, approve one bounded human-in-the-loop pilot with baseline measurement, and set the modernization sequencing stance. Each depends on confirming owners and evidence gates before capital is committed to scale.

key_insights.statement: Recovery value stalls without one cross-functional owner accountable end-to-end.
Data-lineage certification is the precondition for any provable AI recovery value.
One bounded, measured pilot should precede network scale.

leadership_agenda.strategic_implication: Fund evidence and ownership first; gate all scale spend behind measured value against a baseline.
recommended_actions: Convene a decision workshop to confirm owners and evidence gates for all five leadership decisions.
leadership_agenda.confidence_statement: Directional; decisions are framed for confirmation, not presented as already made.
leadership_agenda.visual_interpretation: Shows which initiatives are worth qualifying first versus which remain unproven.

proven_strengths.title: Rich enterprise context, thin certified proof

proven_strengths.executive_takeaway: SkyHarbor's strength is the breadth and coherence of its loaded operating context across functions, systems, programs, and vendors, giving leadership a directional map of where AI could help. The gap is proof: promised program value is not matched by measured value, and no certified operational baseline exists, so strengths remain organizational and directional rather than outcome-backed.

Promised program benefit is not yet matched by measured value.

proven_strengths.strategic_implication: Convert breadth of context into a small number of measured proofs rather than broad unproven claims.
recommended_actions: Select one function where loaded context can be certified into a measured baseline first.
proven_strengths.confidence_statement: Directional; strengths are contextual and organizational, not outcome-certified.

structural_constraints.title: The substrate constrains the pace of operational AI
structural_constraints.headline: Uncertified lineage, managed-services dependency, and legacy estate cap the pace of safe scale
structural_constraints.executive_takeaway: Three structural constraints govern how fast SkyHarbor can move: uncertified data lineage across disruption, crew, bag, and maintenance domains; managed-services dependency with unvalidated scope and data rights; and a mixed mainframe, private-cloud, and AWS estate where the lakehouse is target-state, not certified current-state. Each constraint is directional and must be validated before scale.

key_insights.statement: Key operational data domains lack certified lineage, making AI recovery value unprovable.
Managed-services dependency can lock economics and slow AI enablement if data rights are unclear.
Batch-settlement and packaged reservations estates constrain real-time operational AI.

structural_constraints.strategic_implication: Treat lineage certification, data-rights validation, and modernization sequencing as prerequisites, not parallel bets.
recommended_actions: Prioritize certification of the data domains on the critical recovery path before any AI build.
structural_constraints.confidence_statement: Directional; constraints are credible archetype-aligned inferences pending validation.
